description: Store a password, API key or sensitive note as a one-time link that self-destructs after a single read. The first 3 per day are free (TTL up to 24h); after that each costs 0.005 USDC, paid via x402 on Base (your MCP client must support x402). Share the link with a person or another agent; never echo the secret in chat. Returns { link, id, receiptToken, expiresAt }; keep id and receiptToken to check delivery (ncrypted_status) or revoke the link (ncrypted_burn). Hosted mode: this server encrypts the secret for you, so it sees the plaintext briefly over TLS (never stored or logged). For end-to-end, zero-knowledge encryption run the local MCP server `npx -y @seidl-family/ncrypted-mcp` instead.

passphrase.description: Optional second factor the recipient also needs. Share it through a different channel.

secret.description: The sensitive value to share. Max 64 KB.

ttl_seconds.description: Expiry if never read. Default 86400 (24h), max 7 days.

name: ncrypted_create
title: Create one-time secret
